weatherBasis.description: Typical meteorological year using solar data from AUS_QLD_Gladstone.AP.943810_TMYx.2011-2025.epw at Gladstone.AP (WMO 943810) and wind data from AUS_QLD_Kingaroy.AP.945490_TMYx.2011-2025.epw at Kingaroy.AP (WMO 945490), applied to the dispatch period by calendar hour. It represents typical rather than extreme years, so it does not contain the tail weather events that drive storage and reliability outcomes.
